title: Travel: airport and hotel
intro: From Hazrat Shahjalal Airport to Changi, Dubai and Heathrow: check in, get through security and immigration, sort out hotel problems and find your way around.
introBn: শাহজালাল বিমানবন্দর থেকে সিঙ্গাপুর, দুবাই বা লন্ডন: চেক-ইন, সিকিউরিটি, ইমিগ্রেশন, হোটেলের সমস্যা আর পথ খোঁজার ইংরেজি শিখুন।

units.title: At the airport: check-in to immigration
units.idea: Airport English is mostly short questions and short, clear answers. Answer exactly what is asked, use full sentences, and keep your documents ready.
units.ideaBn: এয়ারপোর্টে প্রশ্ন ছোট, উত্তরও ছোট ও পরিষ্কার হওয়া উচিত। যা জিজ্ঞেস করা হয় ঠিক তার উত্তর দিন।

formula.name: Check-in
formula.pos: I'd like to check in for the flight to Singapore. · Can I have a window seat, please?

formula.name: Security
formula.pos: Do I need to take my laptop out? · Shall I take off my shoes?

formula.name: Immigration
formula.pos: I'm here on holiday / for a conference. · I'm staying for ten days. · I'm staying at…

uses.rule: Purpose of visit: I'm here for/on…
uses.bn: উদ্দেশ্য বলতে I'm here for a conference / on holiday।
uses.ex: I'm here on business. I'm attending a trade fair in Dubai.

uses.rule: How long: I'm staying for + period.
Where: I'm staying at + hotel / with + person.
uses.ex: I'm staying with my cousin in Manchester.

uses.rule: Ask politely at check-in with 'Could I…?'
uses.ex: Could I have an aisle seat, please?

uses.rule: Baggage words: checked bag, carry-on/hand luggage, boarding pass, gate.
uses.ex: How many checked bags do you have? Just one, and this carry-on.

traps.right: I'm here on holiday. / I'm here to visit family.
traps.bn: am come ভুল; I'm here to visit… বলুন।

traps.why: Use 'for' with a period; 'since' needs a starting point.

traps.wrong: I am staying in my uncle.
traps.why: With a person, at/in a place.

drills.q: Immigration officer: "What's the purpose of your visit?"

drills.s: Could I ___ a window seat, please?

drills.q: Pick the best answer: "Do you have anything to declare?"
o: No, I have nothing to declare.
No, I am not declaring nothing.
drills.a: No, I have nothing to declare.
drills.x: Clear full answer; no double negative.

drills.s: Do I need to take my laptop ___ of the bag?
drills.x: Take something out of a bag.

drills.s: Flight EK 583 to Dubai is now ___ at gate 12.

drills.q: Officer in London: "Where are you staying?" Pick the best answer.
o: At the Premier Inn near King's Cross, for five nights.
drills.a: At the Premier Inn near King's Cross, for five nights.

drills.s: I've missed my connecting flight. Could you ___ me on the next one?

units.title: Hotel, directions and transport
units.idea: At the hotel and in the street you make requests, report problems and ask for directions. Use polite question forms and simple, clear descriptions of the problem.
units.ideaBn: হোটেলে আর রাস্তায় আপনাকে অনুরোধ, সমস্যা জানানো আর পথ জিজ্ঞেস করতে হয়। ভদ্র প্রশ্ন আর সহজ বর্ণনা ব্যবহার করুন।

formula.name: Booking
formula.pos: I have a reservation under the name… · I'd like to book a double room for three nights.

formula.name: Problems
formula.pos: The air conditioning isn't working. · There's no hot water in my room.

formula.name: Directions & taxis
formula.pos: Excuse me, could you tell me how to get to…? · How much is it to the airport? · Could you drop me here?

uses.rule: Check in: I have a reservation under (name).
uses.ex: Hi, I have a reservation under Rafi Ahmed.

uses.rule: Report problems with 'isn't working' or 'There's no…'.
uses.bn: সমস্যা জানাতে isn't working / There's no…
uses.ex: The Wi-Fi in room 304 isn't working.

uses.rule: Indirect questions for directions: no inversion after 'Could you tell me'.
uses.bn: Could you tell me এর পর সাধারণ ক্রম।
uses.ex: Could you tell me where the metro station is?

uses.rule: Transport: take a taxi/bus/the metro; get on/off a bus; get in/out of a taxi.
uses.ex: Get off at the third stop, then take a taxi.

uses.rule: Ask the price before the ride.
uses.ex: How much would it be to Dubai Mall?

traps.wrong: Could you tell me where is the station?
traps.right: Could you tell me where the station is?

traps.wrong: The AC is not running properly since yesterday.
traps.right: The AC hasn't been working properly since yesterday.
I'd like to go to the airport, please.
traps.bn: go to the airport; to the বাদ দেবেন না।

drills.s: Hi, I have a reservation ___ the name Rafi Ahmed.
The shower ___ working. Could someone check it?

o: Could you tell me where is the bus stop?
Could you tell me where the bus stop is?
Could you tell me where does the bus stop?
Where the bus stop is, could you tell?
drills.a: Could you tell me where the bus stop is?

drills.s: Get ___ at the next stop for Orchard Road.

o: How much is it to the airport?
How much to go airport is?
How many is it to the airport?
drills.a: How much is it to the airport?

drills.s: Could you drop me ___ the main entrance, please?
What time do we need to ___ out?
The air conditioning ___ working since we arrived.

drills.q: Pick the most polite request to reception.
o: I want another room, this one is bad.
I'm afraid my room is very noisy. Would it be possible to move to a quieter one?
drills.a: I'm afraid my room is very noisy. Would it be possible to move to a quieter one?

mastery.s: "How long are you staying?" "___ about a week."
I'm here ___ business. I have meetings in Singapore.

o: Could you tell me how I can get to the metro?
Could you tell me how can I get to the metro?
Could you tell how I get metro?
Tell me how get to metro?
mastery.a: Could you tell me how I can get to the metro?

o: There's no hot water in my room.
My room has not hot water.
Hot water is not have my room.
There isn't hot water to my room.
mastery.a: There's no hot water in my room.

mastery.s: Could you ___ me at the hotel, please?
Can I have an ___ seat, please?
